message_en: Your maize will need water within two days. Irrigate tomorrow if no rain comes.
message_local: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಳೆ ಬರದಿದ್ದರೆ ನಾಳೆ ನೀರು ಹಾಯಿಸಿ.
reasons: Modelled soil water used so far is 41.0 mm, below the trigger (52.0 mm), but it is projected to reach 55.2 mm within two days.
Forecast rain over today and tomorrow is 0.5 mm.
Maize is 65 days after sowing, in the development stage (Kc 0.75).
source: Open-Meteo weather + modelled soil water balance (soil moisture is not measured)
assumptions: Soil moisture is modelled from weather and crop data, not measured in your field.
